purpose: Future ORIGINAL artwork, separate from already-published image-bank.json. No planned image path should be loaded until assets are committed and tested.

qualityRules.original: Never republish Vretta screenshot art or scrape copyrighted examination images.
qualityRules.realism: Use coherent photographic or hand-illustrated raster assets, not cobbled-together vector characters. Check hands, apparatus and geometry for accuracy.
qualityRules.quantities: Numerical readouts, labels, force arrows, exact scale ticks, coordinates, and scored hotspots remain code/data-driven.
qualityRules.studentSafety: Never encode correct answers in image alt text, file names that appear to students, distinct option styles or visible review buttons.
qualityRules.performance: Export PNG archival source and compressed WebP delivery; optimize for mobile, target under 150 KB per web asset or record a justified exception.
qualityRules.accessibility: Alt text describes observations without answering the question; labelled zones and drag targets are keyboard/touch operable.
qualityRules.provenance: Record whether artwork was generated or photographed, the date, review status, and accessibility description.
